title: Multiplayer Mayhem
description: A cozy Create-focused kitchen-sink modpack built for playing with your friends, automation, building, and unforgettable multiplayer moments. No grindy progression — just pure co-op creativity and chaos.
body:
# Multiplayer Mayhem

A Create-heavy, building-focused kitchen-sink survival modpack made for small groups who just want to play, build, and have fun together. No questlines. No forced progression. Just creativity, automation, and chaos.

🎮 What this modpack offers

Create + addons for big factories, moving machines, trains, automation, and engineering

Huge building variety with decorative blocks, furniture, lighting, biomes, and structures

Quality of Life improvements for smoother multiplayer gameplay

Performance mods so even big bases run well

Optional chaos from extra side-mods — nothing game-breaking, just enough to keep it interesting

Balanced sandbox: players can explore, build, automate, and progress at their own pace

This pack is made for cozy nights with friends, silly projects, accidental disasters, and moments that become inside jokes. We built it for ourselves — now we’re sharing it with you.

🧱 Who is this modpack for?

Players who love Create

Groups who want a chill multiplayer world

Builders who enjoy decoration and creativity

Anyone who enjoys a sandbox with endless possibilities

⚙️ Performance & Stability

The pack includes several optimization and stability mods But is still not optimized fully so expect bugs
